title: Verify: Item icon grids are 16x16, outlined, shaded and palette-only
description: Write game/frontend/tests/itemIcons.test.ts, modelled on tests/roomSources.test.ts, proving ids, sizes, outline, shading and ART_SOURCES wiring from the requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Test asserts six unique item/ ids.
Test asserts each frame is 16x16 with the outline index and at least two other non-zero indices.
Test asserts gridToRgba succeeds for every item frame and ART_SOURCES includes them.
technical_constraints: Unit tests only, no I/O; shared palette only.

steps.action: Import ITEM_SOURCES from ../src/art/itemIcons, ART_SOURCES from ../src/art/sources, rampIndex from ../src/art/draw, gridToRgba from ../src/lib/gridToRgba and PALETTE from ../src/lib/palette. Add it('has six unique item/ ids') expecting ids toEqual the six names old-key, note, book, coin, flashlight, photo prefixed item/ and Set size 6.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/itemIcons.test.ts -t 'unique'

steps.action: For each source assert frames.length is 1, the grid has 16 rows each of length 16, the flattened set contains rampIndex('indigo', 0), and the set has at least 3 distinct values including 0 or two non-outline indices. Also assert gridToRgba(frame, PALETTE) does not throw.
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/itemIcons.test.ts

steps.action: Assert every ITEM_SOURCES id appears in ART_SOURCES.map(s => s.id).
steps.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/itemIcons.test.ts -t 'ART_SOURCES'
